description: Phonon is local text-to-speech for macOS, one keystroke away. A small native menu-bar app with no Dock icon that sends text to a local Ollama speech model and plays the audio back.
The app bundle is a few megabytes; the ~112 MB phonon model lives in Ollama, not in the app. Thirty-eight voices come with the model, from default to Captain Silas Blackwater.
Press ⌃⌥S anywhere to speak the clipboard, or open the panel to type something. The shortcut, voice, endpoint, and launch-at-login all live in Settings.

download.label: Download for Mac
download.note: Needs Ollama with the phonon model: ollama pull phonon. Unsigned build: right-click → Open on first launch.
